claims.claim: Intersect's Technical Steering Committee requests $298,250, equivalent to 1,193,000 ADA, to support TSC activities for 12 months.

The funded work is divided into WP 1 for community-facing technical coordination, WP 2 for protocol governance and evolution, and WP 3 for technical review, with budgets of 256,000 ADA, 832,000 ADA, and 105,000 ADA respectively.

The proposal states that WP 2 funds the Parameter Committee, CIP editors, and Hard Fork Working Group to support evidence-based protocol settings, improvement-pipeline maintenance, and safe protocol upgrade coordination.

The proposal states that WP 3 will establish a pilot independent technical review programme launching in 2027, with conflict-of-interest provisions, published recusals, and reviewer selection through an open process against documented criteria.
Execution of the work packages is contingent on approval of the IntersectMBO budget proposal.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and cites Hydra voting and audited-results references.
The requested amount does not, at time of submission, on its own or in aggregate, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
Independent audits and assurance for the proposal will be provided by Appold, potentially including deliverable verification, control testing, spend validation, and milestone evidence assessment.

The Technical Steering Committee has not received Cardano Treasury funding within the past 24 months, while Intersect and its committees received 22,385,000 ADA through three listed prior treasury withdrawals.

Intersect will administer funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, threshold permissions, external oversight entities, and a public dashboard for auditability.

summary: The document requests 1,193,000 ADA for 12 months of Intersect Technical Steering Committee support across three work packages, with stated governance-process support, NCL compliance, smart-contract administration, external oversight, and return of unspent funds.
